verses.text: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. In both I’ve tried to stir up your sincere thoughts by reminding you
to remember the words spoken earlier by the holy prophets and the command of our Lord and Savior given through your apostles.
First, you should know that in the last days mockers will come, following their own desires.
They’ll say, “Where is this promised coming? Ever since our ancestors died, everything has continued just as it has since creation began.”
They deliberately overlook that long ago the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and through water by God’s word.
By that same word, the world of that time was flooded and destroyed.
But by that same word the present heavens and earth are being kept for fire, held for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly people.
Dear friends, don’t overlook this one thing: with the Lord, one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.
The Lord isn’t slow about keeping his promise, as some people think. Instead, he’s patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but wanting everyone to turn back.
But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar; the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done in it will be exposed.
Since everything will be destroyed this way, what kind of people should you be? Live holy and godly lives
as you look forward to and hasten the coming of the day of God. On that day, the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and the elements will melt in the heat.
But in keeping with his promise, we’re looking forward to new heavens and a new earth, where righteousness lives.
So, dear friends, since you’re looking forward to this, make every effort to be found by him spotless, blameless, and at peace.
Remember that our Lord’s patience means salvation, just as our dear brother Paul wrote to you with the wisdom God gave him.
He writes about these things in all his letters. Some parts are hard to understand, and ignorant and unstable people twist them, just as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
So, dear friends, since you know this ahead of time, be on your guard so you aren’t carried away by the error of lawless people and fall from your secure position.
Instead, grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever. Amen.
